bio.text: Kathy Jennings has been Delaware's Attorney General since January 1, 2019, and is the Democratic candidate for re-election in 2026.
Born and raised in Wilmington, she graduated from the University of Delaware and Villanova University Law School.
She was a prosecutor in the Delaware Department of Justice, serving as State Prosecutor and Chief Deputy Attorney General, and in 2017 was appointed Chief Administrative Officer of New Castle County.
